truthMethod: Development tasks derived from manual reading of the pinned built-in content-type parser and error definition. The first natural-language query exposed a missing implementation file before this manifest was committed; neither task is held out. Neither query provides a symbol, file path, or HTTP status code. Both cover the built-in rejection path when no parser matches and the request is not a 404 fallback; the external error factory and runtime dispatch are not assumed resolved. Required facts and files were fixed before any future ranking change. The second task's irrelevant-file judgments were added later after inspecting selected output and independently reading the pinned source: handleRequest calls contentTypeParser.run before preValidationCallback reaches validation.js, and an undefined parser sends the error and returns; schemas.js selects response schemas by media type. These are development-case judgments, not held-out precision evidence. Other files remain unjudged.
